Step 3. Consider the holomorphic operator \(T_{1540013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the splitting theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1540013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1540013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1540011} \cdot C_{1540012} \cdot C_{1540013}\).
